reason: fix a client-upgrade regression: vendored WORKFLOW.md references gate workflows (pr-ticket-check/pr-link/board-invariant) that forge upgrade does not vendor to clients, breaking client doc-reference checks; also update the stale Gate A description to the declare-all contract

quality.summary: Reviewed the WORKFLOW.md client-safety fix (lite window Q-0046-ccfd). The vendored WORKFLOW.md no longer references the three harness-internal gate workflows by path (pr-ticket-check/pr-link/board-invariant); it names them by function instead, and — correctly — updates Gate A's stale 'exactly one' wording to the declare-all contract from 0033. A guard test parses every COPY_FILES doc for .github/workflows/*.yml references and fails if any is outside COPY_WORKFLOWS, so this regression class cannot recur silently; verified WORKFLOW.md is the only offender and is now clean. Decision 0034 documents the invariant. Minimal, accurate, no over-engineering.

performance.summary: Documentation wording change plus one additive test that reads a handful of small files once. No runtime or hot-path impact.

security.summary: Fixes a vendoring-correctness regression: a client-vendored doc no longer asserts the existence of harness-internal files, so a client upgrade can't break the client's own integrity/doc checks. The added guard test makes the client-safety property enforceable. No code path, trust boundary, or data flow changes.
